incident.failure: A required pretrained model was admitted as the planner/reasoning source for a capability whose substance is reasoning, planning, synthesis, falsification, adaptation, and tool selection.

invariant: A run credited as Brain cognition must contain no MODEL_API, LOCAL_MODEL, or MODEL_ARTIFACT in its execution dependency path. Model-assisted outputs may be preserved only as supplier/reference/component evidence, never as Brain reasoning acquisition, fresh cognitive reuse, or cognitive frontier-dependency removal.

negative_case.note: Even an 'optional' model in the credited cognition execution path must reject; optional labeling cannot launder model reasoning into Brain reasoning.
